decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service remains outside our core maritime business and offers no clear synergies, so we discontinue it.
The maritime education programme has quickly built a partner network and aligns with our training expertise, so we keep it.
The emissions monitoring and compliance services are close to our core and successfully met the FuelEU deadline, so we keep them.
The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into our PAL software and supports client regulatory compliance, so we keep it.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is integrated into PAL and helps clients plan costs, so we keep it.
